v1_geometry_review.method: Independent reopened mesh points. Exact linear AABB/junction overlap intervals plus 1441 half-frame samples. No producer QA or harness executable imported.
limits: Exact route-state proof is limited to continuous linear translation against static deck XY bounds and the authored linear rotation attribute; it is not continuous collision proof.
Only listed overhead service families count toward the 14 m distribution envelope; local equipment, racks, columns and vertical equipment drops remain present.
Added assembly checks use conservative AABBs and 1441 finite times; no all-pairs scene proof.

v1_producer_gui_observations.method: Foreground Blender USD import; viewport draw handler records completed POST_PIXEL draws. Controlled orbit via view quaternion timer; native screen.animation_play with sync_mode NONE (play every frame).
v1_producer_gui_observations.visibility: Solid material-color view of imported scene; lights/cameras hidden as viewport helpers; roof/front facade/explanation hidden for inspection.
v1_producer_gui_observations.limits: Automated orbit and native timeline observations in Blender import. No claim of Hydra performance, photoreal playback, or perfect USD importer parity. No keyframe evaluation timings substituted for completed viewport draws.
